(b) The Tenderer shall have Successfully Completed of 01 (One ) No Air- Cooler Servicing & Maintenance Works of
minimum amount Tk.16.25 (Sixteen lac twenty five thousand) Lac single Contract within last 05 ( Five) years Under in
Govt./ Semi Govt./ Autonomous body. i.e Counting backward from the date of publication of IFT in the News Paper/
Website.
(c) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 20.00
(Twenty) Lac only.
(d) Annual Electro - Mechanical Turnover : Last five years ( Financial year 2019-2020, 2020-2021 , 2021-2022, 2022-2023,
2023-2024 ) Average Annual Turnover should be required minimum Amount Tk. 20.00 (Twenty) Lac.
(e) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC Category Contractory & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh
Electrical Licensing Board.
(f) The Tenderer must have Income Tax clearance Certificate (2022-2023).
(g) The Tenderer must have VAT/BIN Registration Certificate.
(h) The Tenderer must have valid Trade License (2023-2024)
